Some investigations begin with questions. Others quickly turn into something far more disturbing. As the Ghost Adventures crew enters locations surrounded by reports of paranormal activity, unexplained encounters and chilling discoveries make every lockdown more intense. When the evidence starts piling up, the team must face whatever is waiting in the darkness.
Watch Ghost Adventures, S10, Episodes 13, 10, 1, 6, 3, 4 & 8 on Discovery Channel India.
